unsupported_operations.reason: No specialized QEMU text/character-console client; generic handshake alone does not assert JSON console semantics.
No specialized VNC binary client. JSON event/upload receive API does not represent a VNC stream.

policies.authentication: Supplied root transport owns origin/TLS/handler/session handshake; facades never forge token headers.
policies.outer_version: Runtime root uses discovered current major; literal v8 is provenance.
policies.upload_pipeline: Start ACK before binaries; one continuous reader accepts progress while serial writer pipelines chunks without per-chunk ACK. Final correlated ACK with complete=true/total_len is required.
policies.correlation: Fresh socket request IDs 1=start/data, 2=finalize, 3=explicit cancel; registration ID1. Request_id/action mismatches fail protocol. No mutation replay.
policies.resume: Only explicitly sets force=resume. Never reads Length/Position or seeks the caller stream; size optional and caller supplied.
policies.ownership: High-level SendAsync owns socket/session and leaves source stream open. OpenAsync transfers session ownership to caller. Event enumeration/disposal closes subscription.
policies.cancellation: Token cancellation, stream failure and disposal close/abort without upload_cancel, retaining partial file. Explicit CancelAsync is destructive.
policies.generic_result: Common event envelope explicitly documents extensible result; JsonElement may be retained and deserialized with caller source-generated metadata. Known payloads use established model contexts.
policies.registration: OpenAsync sends register; reader validates ACK if received and supports direct subsequent notification, without inventing mandatory ACK ordering.
policies.source_event_split: Typed LAN matching reconstructs exact qualified source_event rather than guessing the underscore split boundary.

exclusions.reason: Deprecated former HTTP file-transfer mechanism is never used.

limitations: Each high-level file upload gets its own socket; no connection pooling/multiple sequential files API.
No automatic reconnect, resubscription or resume policy.
No inferred server chunk window, timeout, response ordering guarantee or bytes-normalization.
Server source names and unknown event tokens are preserved; outgoing builder exposes only four documented event registrations.
